body:

And north-west WA
[kingOfDeals] Binglee is selling it for $100 with 12% cashback in gift card if you by before tonight.
[bcYield] The detect kitchen set has been OOS on both Amazon and Binglee.
https://www.binglee.com.au/products/detect-kitchen-system-bl…
[stickyfingers] Had an $8 off kitchen voucher in my new Amazon account (needed a Prime trial) so for $86.05 delivered I am very happy. Hoping the dough kneading feature works well as that’s what had me sold.
[gummibeer] Great machine! Owned for 3 years, used regularly. Never had any issues.
[kaybrr] "Owned for 3 years, used regularly. Never had any issues."
Do you mean specifically the machine hasn't had any issues or you have just generally had a winning streak in life since purchasing the machine, a sort of good-luck charm I guess?
[Click_It] I see where you're going. $99 (the price just increased slightly) is cheaper than finding a buddha's belly to rub.
